item.text:
**8B.1 Research Note: Ali Khamenei, 2024**

**Assessment**
Yes. Khamenei articulated a fairly clear governing program in 2024, but it was mostly sloganized and ideology-heavy rather than technocratic. The clearest themes were:
- `resistance economy` and domestic production as the answer to Iran’s economic weakness
- anti-Israel regional resistance and willingness to use force
- regime-control through loyalist vetting and controlled institutions
- selective claims of restraint in the nuclear file, but only at the declaratory or tactical level

**Evidence**

- [Khamenei and Raisi Speeches on Nowruz](https://iranprimer.usip.org/index.php/blog/2024/mar/21/khamenei-and-raisi-speeches-nowruz) | The Iran Primer / USIP | 2024-03-21  
  Claim: Khamenei said the economy was Iran’s “main weakness,” framed domestic production as the key to fixing inflation, employment, and the national currency, and said foreign agreements should become “national executive contracts” with tangible results. He also warned that enemies were using the media to distort the economy. This is the clearest 2024 statement of an explicit governing program.  
  IDs: `8B.1`, `7B.10`, `7B.8`, `7B.9`

- [Supreme Leader Khamenei says Iran demonstrated its power against Israel](https://uk.investing.com/news/world-news/irans-khamenei-thanks-armed-forces-for-attack-on-israel-3445183) | Reuters | 2024-04-21  
  Claim: Khamenei thanked the armed forces for the April strike on Israel, said Iran had demonstrated its power, and urged continued military innovation. That shows an explicit strategic preference for deterrence through force, not restraint.  
  IDs: `8B.1`, `7B.10`, `7B.8`

- [Iran leader Khamenei, rifle at his side, vows resistance against Israel](https://theprint.in/world/iran-leader-khamenei-rifle-at-his-side-vows-resistance-against-israel/2297444/) | Reuters | 2024-10-04  
  Claim: In his first Friday sermon in nearly five years, Khamenei said resistance against Israel would not back down and cast U.S. and allied policy as cover for seizing regional resources. This is a direct statement of strategic direction and a revealed geopolitical worldview.  
  IDs: `8B.1`, `7B.10`, `7B.8`

- [Factbox-Who in Iran seeks the presidency after Raisi’s death?](https://theprint.in/world/factbox-who-in-iran-seeks-the-presidency-after-raisis-death/2146029/) | Reuters | 2024-06-25  
  Claim: Reuters described the Guardian Council screening 80 applicants down to six and said Khamenei has the final say in state matters. That reveals a clear regime-control structure and a preference for loyalist governance.  
  IDs: `8B.1`, `7B.9`, `7B.8`

- [Iran says nuclear weapons have no place in its nuclear doctrine](https://www.yahoo.com/news/iran-says-nuclear-weapons-no-085328983.html) | Reuters | 2024-04-22  
  Claim: Iran publicly restated that nuclear weapons are not part of its doctrine, and Reuters noted Khamenei’s long-standing fatwa. This is explicit doctrinal signaling and a formal commitment that can be compared against later behavior.  
  IDs: `8B.1`, `7B.10`, `7B.8`

- [Tehran signals no retaliation against Israel after drones attack](https://theprint.in/world/tehran-signals-no-retaliation-against-israel-after-drones-attack/2048236/) | Reuters | 2024-04-19  
  Claim: Tehran downplayed the Isfahan incident and said it had no retaliation plan, which Reuters said appeared aimed at averting regional war. This is a counter-signal showing tactical restraint and flexibility, not a lack of strategy.  
  IDs: `8B.1`, `7B.10`, `7B.8`

- [Iran will not impede IAEA access, head of its atomic organisation says](https://theprint.in/world/iran-will-not-impede-iaea-access-head-of-its-atomic-organisation-says/2403254/) | Reuters | 2024-12-14  
  Claim: Iran said it would not obstruct IAEA access and would work within safeguards. This is a narrow late-year procedural commitment, useful as a benchmark against the year’s earlier noncooperation.  
  IDs: `8B.1`, `7B.10`, `7B.8`, `7B.6`

- [IAEA board passes resolution against Iran on cooperation, inspectors](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-resolution-against-iran-on-cooperation-inspectors-3472087) | Reuters | 2024-06-05  
  Claim: Reuters reported Iran had barred many experienced inspectors, prompting the IAEA Board to demand reversal. This undercuts the credibility of Khamenei’s public restraint posture and shows a gap between doctrine and practice.  
  IDs: `8B.1`, `7B.10`, `7B.8`, `7B.6`

**Synthesis**
- Clear ideological core: anti-Israel resistance, sanctions-resistant “domestic production,” people’s participation, and regime loyalty filtering.
- Clear evaluability: he repeatedly announced annual slogans and doctrinal lines that can be compared against later actions.
- Main limitation: the program is broad and symbolic, often framed as slogans rather than detailed policy design.
- Biggest counter-signal: tactical restraint in April and late-year IAEA openness, which show flexibility, but not absence of a governing line.
